sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour  following:
 ORDER

This first criminal appeal is filed by the appellant under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.180/2023, dated 25.5.2023, registered at Police Station Gadhwa District Singrauli for commission of offence under Sections 376,376(2)(n),450, 506 of IPC and Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act.

As prayed by learned counsel for the appellant, this Criminal Appeal under Section 14-A of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. to the appellant - Pintu @ Rajbali Kewat is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
As prayed by learned counsel for the appellant, this Criminal Appeal under Section 14-A of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. to the appellant - Pintu @ Rajbali Kewat is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed, appellant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after evidence of prosecutrix before the trial Court and after receipt of the DNA report.
